text.en: Tree-based models v.s. deep learning is row 79 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Evaluation Analysis area.
text.zh: Tree-based models v.s. deep learning 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 79 行，所属领域为“评测与分析”。

text.en: The annual table associates Tree-based models v.s. deep learning with “Why do tree-based models still outperform deep learning on tabular data?”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Tree-based models v.s. deep learning 与论文《Why do tree-based models still outperform deep learning on tabular data?》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Leo Grinsztajn, Gael Varoquaux”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Leo Grinsztajn（官方页拼写）、Gael Varoquaux（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Leo Grinsztajn, Gael Varoquaux”。
